Child ownership is scoped to the selected session and host. Worker/harness assignment linkage, cross-host integration, grouped completion and versioned shared context remain pending.

Browser checks render production components with local fixtures; backend HTTP/Git contracts are tested separately with real services and temporary Git fixtures. No deployed or installed-app runtime claim.
